SELECT dl.id, dl.dispatch_no, dl.list_status, dl.created_at, SUM(CASE WHEN wd.row_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_dealer_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN wd.id IS NOT NULL AND wd.row_status != 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_dealer_rows FROM t_dispatch_list dl LEFT JOIN t_waybill w ON w.dispatch_list_id = dl.id LEFT JOIN t_waybill_dealer wd ON wd.waybill_id = w.id WHERE dl.deleted = 0
AND dl.dispatch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.dispatchNo}, '%')
GROUP BY dl.id, dl.dispatch_no, dl.list_status, dl.created_at ORDER BY dl.id DESC
